VHE is a high-tech company with approximately 170 colleagues and growing ambitions. As an experienced forklift driver, you will work for a specialist in the fruit and vegetable (AGF) sector. Operating a forklift, you will use your keen attention to detail to ensure that the right products end up in the right place. If you notice that a fellow forklift driver is busy moving pallets, you will not hesitate to lend a helping hand. Teamwork and collegiality are therefore highly important!
